    Questions & Answers

    What is Notion used for?

    Notion is a connected workspace that brings docs, wikis, projects, and databases together in one place. With Notion AI and custom agents built in, it also helps teams automate repetitive work—like weekly reporting, meeting follow-ups, and onboarding.

    Is Notion free to use?

    Yes. Notion's free plan includes unlimited pages, Notion AI, and core features like docs, wikis, and databases. Paid plans start at $10 per member per month (billed annually) for teams that need more advanced features, custom agents, and deeper integrations.

    How is Notion different from other productivity tools?

    Most tools solve just one problem—a wiki here, a task tracker there. Notion brings all of that into one connected workspace with flexible building blocks that adapt to how your team actually works, plus Notion AI to help find answers and move projects forward.

    What are custom agents in Notion?

    Custom agents are AI teammates you can build to handle multi-step tasks using context from your Notion workspace, connected apps like Slack and GitHub, and the web. They follow your instructions, work around the clock, and take action right where your team already works.

    Can Notion replace multiple tools for my team?

    Yes—many teams consolidate their separate doc editors, wikis, project trackers, and meeting note apps into Notion. With features like AI Meeting Notes and Enterprise Search, plus integrations with tools like Slack, Google Drive, and GitHub, nothing gets lost along the way.
